clocks.observer_receive: UTC wall-clock time when the observer receives a state
clocks.model_time: FMU simulation time_s retained independently from wall clock
clocks.packet_capture: capture-host timestamp subject to host synchronization
clocks.historian_sample: Influx sample timestamp compared with observer wall clock

rules: Never silently substitute one clock for another.
Record host synchronization status during server acceptance.
Latency metrics must declare their two timestamp sources.
Cross-host timing claims require documented synchronization evidence.
